name: VALENTINO
summary: VALENTINO Cabazon is a luxury fashion boutique offering the Italian house's complete collections of ready-to-wear, iconic Rockstud accessories, handbags, and shoes for women and men. This elegant store provides a premium shopping experience featuring seasonal collections and exclusive collaborations in the heart of Southern California's luxury retail corridor.
demographics: The Cabazon area attracts a diverse mix of visitors, including affluent tourists and shoppers from nearby Palm Springs and Los Angeles seeking luxury goods at the adjacent Desert Hills Premium Outlets. The trade area serves upper-middle to high-income households with significant discretionary spending power, particularly those interested in designer fashion and luxury brands. Primary visitors include fashion-conscious adults aged 25-55, often traveling specifically for high-end shopping experiences, with a notable presence of international tourists and weekend shoppers from Southern California's metropolitan areas.
description: VALENTINO at Cabazon represents the Italian luxury fashion house's presence in one of Southern California's premier shopping destinations. Located at 48650 Seminole Drive in Cabazon, this boutique showcases Valentino's complete range of haute couture offerings, from the iconic Rockstud collection to ready-to-wear pieces, handbags, shoes, and accessories for both women and men. The store features Valentino's signature elegant aesthetic, displaying collections that include the Panthea line, Studdy accessories, VLogo Signature pieces, and exclusive collaborations like Valentino Garavani and Vans. Open daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, the boutique provides a refined shopping experience with personalized service, allowing customers to explore seasonal collections including the Cruise 2026 lines and special selections. With a strong 4.2-star rating from 51 reviews, this location serves as a destination for luxury fashion enthusiasts seeking the craftsmanship and timeless elegance that has defined the Valentino brand since its founding.
